community_list_entries.section: Resources / Benchmarks and Tasks / Long-Term Memory Evaluation
community_list_entries.name: StoryBench

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A long-term memory benchmark built on an interactive-fiction game (311 scene nodes, 86 choice nodes). Choices depend on events from earlier turns, scored by knowledge-retention and sequential-reasoning metrics in immediate-feedback and self-recovery modes. The paper gives no code or data URL.
